Commentary.Commentary: That's it from us for today. Hope you enjoyed this game as much as we did to bring it to you. The action now shifts to Victoria. Can the Sri Lankans win their second consecutive T20I series or will Australia bounce back? Do join us on February 19 at 1920 Local time (0820 GMT). Good bye. Take care!

Sri Lanka skipper, Upul Tharanga firstly wants to thank the Sri Lankan supporters in Colombo. Adds that they were quite supportive through the series in South Africa and also acknowledges the support in Melbourne. States that it's a good feeling to beat Australia on their home turf and credits his boys for the kind of performance they put in. Realizes that fielding is one department they really need to improve on and it's something they need to improve on.

Australia skipper, Aaron Finch credits the Sri Lankans for a good outing. Says that even Australia batted brilliantly. He praises Turner for removing both set batsmen in the 18th over. Admits that 18 off 18 was not easy to defend but he gave them a chance. He also agrees that they couldn't build on the start they got and should've got a couple of more 15-run overs. Ends his talk by saying that they haven't performed as they would have liked in this format of the game and that is something they can improve.

Asela Gunaratne has been named the Man of the Match for a brisk and scintillating fifty, which was his first in this format. He was the highest scorer for the Islanders and he just took the game away from Australia.

Earlier in the day, Australia managed to power past a score of 160 as the top ordered fired and fired well. If only their middle order could captialize on that and add a few more runs, things might have been different for them.

Australia didn't really bowl well. They could have done better but the captaincy from Aaron Finch didn't help either. The hosts were battered for runs at the start and hit all over. Ashton Turner brought them back in the game by picking up two wickets in a single over, but that wasn't enough. His spin partner Adam Zampa bowled well but there wasn't enough support from the rest.

Gunaratne and Siriwardana then carried on and built on that platform, adding 60 runs and getting their team closer. But the former played a reckless shot which saw him and his partner depart within no time. It all went right down to the last ball of the innings, but some sensible batting from Kapugedera and Prasanna towards the end ensured that Sri Lanka got through and nicked the victory.

A thrilling finish to the game as Sri Lanka have managed to get themselves across the finish line. Although, it can be argued that they should have done it rather comfortably instead of dragging it to the last delivery. With 169 to chase, the Lankans lost their skipper in the very first over but Dickwella and Munaweera started the onslaught from there. They stitched a quickfire 74-run partnership that more or less set the platform for the away team.

FOUR! YES HE CAN! Kapugedera slaps this through covers and find the boundary. What a way to win this thriller. The Sri Lankan fans have thoroughly enjoyed this match. Certainly so, they couldn't have asked for anything better. It was necessary to be calm in this pressure situation and Kapugedera held his nerves on the last ball. Coming back to delivery, it was a full ball, outside off, which Kapugedera drove through sweeper cover to ensure that SRI LANKA WIN THIS MATCH BY 5 WICKETS AND LEAD THE 3-MATCH SERIES 1-0!
The keeper is right up to the stumps. Everybody has creeped in, circling the batsman, wanting to save the run. Are we in for a Super Over? Or can Kapugedera finish it off?

Nail biting stuff! Kapugedera pulls this short delivery through square leg and sets off immediately. He has two runs on his mind and forces Prasanna to come for it. Deep square leg throws it wide and they complete it easily. Two runs added to the total! 1 run needed off 1!
Length ball, slower one, Prasanna tries to pull but misses and it hits his inside edge and goes towards the off side. They run through.
Length ball, around middle and leg, Kapugedera pulls it through fine leg and runs one.

NOT OUT! Short of a length delivery, outside off, Prasanna attempts a similar shot but only connects thin air. But this time around, Kapugedera asks him to come for a single. Paine's underarm throw misses the striker's end and goes towards Tye who has a shy at non striker's end. Australia think they have got their man. But replays suggest Prasanna has made his ground.
A run out appeal against Seekkuge Prasanna is taken upstairs. Looked like he's safe in real time. We'll know for sure now though...
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Prasanna pulls blindly and misses. Dot ball. 6 needed off 5.
Andrew Tye to bowl the final over. He has 6 runs to defend. Can he do it for his team?
Leg bye! A half hearted appeal as Prasanna gets rapped on the pads in front of the sticks, but the umpire turns it down. They run a leg bye. Six runs needed off the last over.
Length delivery, outside off, cuts it through covers and rotates the strike. One run added to the total!
Another slower delivery, outside off, Kapugedera looks to cut but fails to connect.
Slower one, on the sticks, Prasanna flicks it very calmly to backward square leg and runs one.
WIDE! Faulkner sprays this one way outside off and umpire calls it a wide.
Back of a length delivery, around middle, Kapugedera pulls it in front of square for a single.

Full delivery, outside off, Prasanna looks to cut but gets the inside edge and ball falls on the pitch itself. They steal a single. Paine runs in to effect a run out but the batsmen were very fast there to complete the run.
James Faulkner is back.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful stroke. Tosses this one outside off, Prasanna cuts this through point, the sweeper cover gives it a chase, even dives but the ball beats him and goes for a boundary.
Prasanna looks to cut but misses. Paine is interested in caught behind, but the umpire turns it down.
Seekkuge Prasanna is the new batsman in. 17 runs are needed to win off 15 deliveries.

OUT! That is a very, very strange decision and certainly controversial. Sprays this down the leg side, Siriwardana looks to tuck it through leg side but misses and gets rapped on the pads. The umpire signals him out instantly. And in no time, Australia have sent back both the set batsmen. Do we have a twist in tale here? Replays suggest that it was missing the leg stump.
Kapugedera works it around through square leg for a single.
Chamara Kapugedera is the new man in for Sri Lanka.

OUT! Gunaratne looks to play the reverse sweep, but misses as Paine completes a sharp stumping. The part-timer has struck. Tossed up delivery, around off, Gunaratne tries to be cheeky and fails to connect. Paine knows it's out and urges the umpire to go up. The umpire obliges and the replays show that Gunaratne has failed to land his bat back in time.
A stumping appeal against Asela Gunaratne is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Ashton Turner will have a go with the ball.
Length ball, around leg, Gunaratne pulls it fine and sets off for an easy single.
Short delivery, around off, Siriwardana looks to pull but finds the edge that goes towards the leg side. They run a single.
Gunaratne flicks this length delivery through square leg for a single.
Maiden T20I fifty for Asela Gunaratne!

FOUR! Gunaratne seems to be in the zone. He has not been perturbed by anything that is happening on the field. Short of a length delivery, outside off, Gunaratne upper cuts it, there was a fielder positioned for that very shot but it falls just away for him and goes for a boundary. Gets to his fifty with that shot.
On a length, around middle, Gunaratne moves back, wanting to cut but misses.
FOUR! Length ball, outside off, Gunaratne opens the face of the bat, uses the pace of the ball and plays it fine for a boundary.
Length ball, around middle and leg, Gunaratne looks to flick but only manages to get the leading edge that flies towards mid off, but it falls short of him. They run a single.
FOUR! Wristy! Back of a length delivery, around leg, Gunaratne swivels across and plays the lap shot past the fine leg fielder. Runs coming quite easily for the visitors.
FOUR! Brilliant batting from Sri Lanka. On a length, outside off, Gunaratne cuts it through the point fielder for a comfortable boundary.
Length ball, outside off, Gunaratne dabs it through point and runs a couple.
Back of a length delivery, around middle, Gunaratne pulls it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Asela Gunaratne is on the floor after being hit on the box on that last delivery. Some would feel, especially Faulkner, that he had that coming, trying to play such an audacious shot.

OUCH! That has got to hurt, Gunaratne is hit in the box as he tries to be cheeky. Length delivery, around leg, he gets into the left hander's position trying to hit over point, but he misses and is struck. He's down on the ground, but fortunately seems fine and is ready to go.
James Faulkner is back into the attack.
Length ball, outside off, Gunaratne moves across and edges his drive intentionally to third man for a single.
Short of a length delivery, Gunaratne shuffles across looking to scoop, Cummins follows him and bowls it wide off him. The umpire doesn't signal it as a wide.
FOUR! Full delivery, around leg, Gunaratne goes behind and slices it over point. Pure placement, times it perfectly and the third man had no chance to cut it off.
Back of a length delivery, head height, Gunaratne pulls it straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Marginally ahead of length, around leg, Siriwardana moves across a bit and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off, Gunaratne guides it down to third man and runs one.
Pat Cummins is reintroduced into the attack.
Fires it well outside off, looks to go after it but misses.
FOUR! Stand and deliver stuff from Milinda Siriwardana. Full around off, the southpaw stands firm and pummels it over mid off. Nobody out there and it will be a boundary.
Length ball outside off, it's played to point for a run.

FOUR! Edged and away! Shortish delivery banged in on middle and off, Gunaratne goes for the big pull but gets a big top edge on it. It flies over the keeper's head and it races away to the boundary line.
Bumper outside off, it's rising quite sharply as Asela doesn't have anything to do with that.

FOUR! What a shot! Picked the gap well and placed it to perfection. Length ball on the stumps, Gunaratne gives the charge and lofts it right between mid off and extra cover. Sends it all the way for the boundary.
Andrew Tye is back on.
Gunaratne punches this full delivery through covers for a single.
Siriwardana dances down the track and cuts this past point. Stanlake chases it with Henriques, he falls near the boundary but manages to save a run for his team. Three runs added to the total!
Looped up delivery, around off, Gunaratne cuts it over backward point. One run added to the total!
Floated delivery outside off, Siriwardana lofts it over the covers for an easy single.
Short and flatter, Siriwardana pulls this through mid-wicket for a brace.

DROPPED! Tosses this one around off,  Gunaratne looks to pull it past Aaron Finch at mid-wicket who dives but fails to hold onto it. It was a difficult chance and he did well to get there. They run a single.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
Length ball around off, it's dropped on the off side with soft hands for a brisk run.
Good length ball on middle and off, Asela paddles it fine down the leg side. Places it towards fine leg for a single.
Fine leg drops back...
Back of a length delivery angling across, Siriwardana stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish in length around off, Gunaratne kneels across to sweep it away but misses and is hit on the pads. It rolls to the on side as the batsmen take a leg bye.
A bit too straight from Faulkner, bowls in on a length on middle and leg, it's worked to mid-wicket for nothing.
James Faulkner is back on to bowl.
Around off, it's dropped in front of covers for a quick single.
Flatter ball on middle stumps, it's worked in front of mid-wicket for a single.
Milinda Siriwardana is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Zampa with another wicket! A half-tracker on off, Munaweera gets back and pulls this away hard. Unfortunately for him, it's straight into the hands of Aaron Finch at short mid-wicket who takes an excellent catch. Dilshan will be disappointed with that, he was looking good and doing a lot of damage.
Short, flat and outside off, Munaweera hangs back and cuts it through backward point. Uses the field well as he places it well in the gap. Gets two runs for it.
Zampa once again tosses it right up there, Gunaratne dances down once more and flicks it through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, Gunaratne steps out and plays it back to the bowler.
Goes full for the first time but it's sliding down, Gunaratne nudges it to fine leg for one. 8 runs off the over!
Wide! Short and down the leg side, Gunaratne tries pulling but misses.
Shortish on middle, pulled past backward square leg for a couple.
A little short in length on off, Dilshan gets back to make room and punches it in the air over covers. There is a sweeper on the off side and hence only a run.
A touch short in length again, around middle, Gunaratne turns it off his hips through backward square leg for one.
Back of a length on off, angling in, Asela tries to flick but it takes the splice of the bat and moves to covers.
Short of a length ball on off, it's calmly pulled through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Billy Stanlake back into the bowling attack.
Googly for the new batsman, spinning down the leg side, Asela flicks it off the inside half of the bat. It goes wide of short fine leg for one.
Asela Gunaratne is the next batsman in.

OUT! Massive breakthrough for Australia! A slider around off, angling away from the southpaw, Dickwella stays back to turn it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early. It pops out off the leading edge and goes straight into the hands of Klinger at short third man. 90 needed off 67 balls!
FOUR! Fab shot by Niroshan! Loopy full ball, Dickwella kneels down and reverse sweeps it from around leg. Middles it nicely and sends it over the point region for a boundary.
Flighted full ball on off, Munaweera goes for the slog but fails to middle it. Ends up forcing it down to long on for a run.
Short and wide outside off, cut with the spin to point.
Slow loopy ball on middle, it's flicked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up ball on middle, Dickwella clips it through mid-wicket for a single. His partner wants the second run but is sent back.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Tickles it off his pads and runs across for a single as the ball travels in the deep on the leg side.
Tossed up ball on off, Dickwella plays a reverse sweep but finds short third man.
Loopy full on leg, Munaweera top edges his attempted paddle sweep and it falls safely at square leg. A single taken.
Tossed up ball on middle, Munaweera gets down on one knee and sweeps it through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Ashton Turner to bowl now.
Loopy and full on off, Munaweera skips down the track and forces it off the inner half of the bat to long on for a run.
Flatter on off, it's pushed from the crease to covers.
Flighted leg spinner outside off, Munaweera advances down the track and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Goes down and paddles it wide of short fine leg for a single.
Googly pitching outside leg, Dickwella fails to flick and is hit on the back leg.
Gets back on the back foot and punches it through covers for one.
Adam Zampa is introduced into the bowling attack.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single. 62/1 after the end of the Powerplay overs!
Full toss on off, Munaweera picks it late and only manages to push it straight to mid off.
FOUR! The bowler doesn't learn there, bowls a full ball on the pads again and this time Dilshan hammers it over backward square leg for a boundary.

In the air... safe! Full and angling down, Munaweera flicks it off his pads, doesn't bother to keep it down and luckily for him it falls in the no man's land at deep square leg. Two runs added to the total.
Shortish on off, slower in pace, Munaweera stands back to steer it down to third man but gets a bottom edge behind to the keeper. On one bounce it goes.
EDGY FOUR! Unlucky for the bowler! He bowls a full length delivery in the channel outside off, Munaweera makes room to drive it through covers but gets a big fat outside edge to the third man fence.
Andrew Tye is brought into the attack.
Again Faulkner takes the pace off the ball and lands it a touch short outside off, Dickwella flashes and misses.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
Another slower one outside off, Munaweera throws his bat at it but fails to connect. Taking the pace off the ball is working in Faulkner's favour.
Clever change in pace this time, outside off and Munaweera is deceived.
FOUR! Bang! Munaweera is looking in red-hot form. Faulkner angles across a full ball and Munaweera charges down the track immediately. Smacks it with all his might through mid off for a boundary.
Remains on the back foot and defends it back to the bowler.
James Faulkner is into the attack now.

SIX! 24 runs off the over, a very expensive one for Australia! Talk about this shot, exemplary execution. Goes down on one knee and just utilizes the extra pace of the bowler. Connects exceedingly well with his scoop shot and clears the fine leg field for a maximum.
FIVE WIDES! Stanlake bends his back and bowls a bouncer. It goes well over the batsman and keeper for a boundary. Bonus runs for Sri Lanka and they are off to a flier!

Angles across a shortish ball around off, Dickwella tries to get down and paddle scoop but misses. There is some deflection and noise, the Aussies appeal but nothing from the umpire. The replays show the involvement of Niroshan's helmet.
On a length outside off, Munaweera tries to go aerial over covers but ends up slicing it past backward point to third man. One run added to the total.
FOUR! And again. Dilshan is targeting Stanlake here. Another shorter ball around off, Munaweera jumps back on the leg side and smashes it over cover-point for a boundary.
FOUR! He is a strong hitter of a cricket ball! Shortish and around off, Munaweera moves back to make room and slams it over backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! Shot! Fullish and angling on off, Munaweera aligns himself and drills it back past the bowler, past mid off and gets a boundary.
FOUR! Fabulous shot! Cummins errs on the pads, Dickwella moves away from the line and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman has dug out that yorker at the last second.
A leg slip comes in place...
The batsman attempts to hook that one but fails to make contact.
Terrific yorker, around leg, Dickwella hops back and does well to dig it out at the last moment.
Shortish outside off, slapped over covers for three runs.
Width on offer outside off, Munaweera throws his bat at it but fails to connect.

Sharp delivery, on a length and around leg, Dickwella tries playing the paddle shot but fails to middle. There is some sound as it goes past him, not sure off what, maybe pads or bat but anyway it doesn't carry to the keeper.
FOUR! Stanlake goes short again, around middle and leg, Niroshan rides the bounce and pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Play and a miss! Outside off, Dickwella gets back, flashes his blade and misses.

FOUR! Not quite from the middle of the bat. Short of a length delivery around middle, Dickwella gets his pull shot away and the ball flies off the outer half of the bat. Flies over backward square leg and goes for a boundary.
Shortish on off, punched off the back foot to the off side.

Appeal for an lbw! That looked close but the umpire shook his head. A fuller length delivery, sharp and landing around leg, Dickwella was beaten for pace as he failed to connect with his flick shot. That rapped him on the pads, they appealed but nothing from the umpire. The replays showed that it pitched on leg and was going on to hit the leg stump. Dickwella is lucky to be still out there.
Wide! Another wayward delivery, down the leg side, Niroshan once again fails to make any use of it.
Wide! Shortish and down the leg side, Dickwella swings his bat with an attempted pull shot but makes no connection.
Billy Stanlake to bowl from the other end.
Dilshan Munaweera walks in at No.3.

OUT! Cricket is a team game. The fielding effort on the last ball meant that it's three and not a boundary which brought Tharanga on strike and Cummins bowled a beauty to dismiss him. A length delivery around middle and off, nipping away a shade, Tharanga is caught napping inside the crease, has a gentle push inside the line and gets a thick outside edge to the keeper. Paine makes no mistake and Australia draw first blood!

Good effort by Head! Cummins angles across a back of a length ball outside off and Dickwella steers it through point. Head gives the chase and pulls it back just before the ropes. Tye, who has moved across to his left from third man, collects the ball and throws it back in place. Three runs taken.
A touch short and going down leg, Dickwella shuffles across with a premeditated paddle but misses. Strangely, it's not called a wide. Hmm...
Shortish again, around middle, Dickwella moves back and mistimes his shot back towards the bowler.
Slips a sharp ball down the leg side, Upul fails to flick and it goes off his pads to backward square leg for a leg bye.
Starts with a shortish length ball in the line of the stumps, Niroshan makes space by moving towards leg and forces towards wide mid off. They cross for a quick single. Sri Lanka are away!
Welcome back for the run chase. Upul Tharanga and Niroshan Dickwella are the Sri Lankan openers. Pat Cummins to steam in first up with a slip. Here we go...
